# Brendon Mapinda — Creative Studio + Automation Lab

> Cape Town–based creative studio and automation lab run by Brendon Mapinda. Two paths, chosen from the landing page: premium photography & content (the Studio), and software & automation (Systems). Brand promise: premium visuals, smart systems, business growth — helping brands look premium and run smarter.

## Site structure

- **Landing** (`/`): a chooser — Photography & Content, or Software & Automation.
- **Studio** (`/studio.html`): photography & video.
- **Systems** (`/systems.html`): AI automation, software & business optimization.

## The Studio (photography & content)

Editorial portraits, brand & venue content (lounges, bars, products, personalities), cinematic short-form reels for Instagram/TikTok, and event coverage (graduations, baby showers, brand activations). Photographer/cinematographer since 2017, with eight years refining a single editorial aesthetic — Lightroom-finished, premium, moody and lifestyle-led. Paid client work includes Reebok South Africa, GoodHope FM and a Du Toitskloof wine shoot, alongside portraits of Miss SA contestants.

Session pricing (South African Rand): Mini R500 · Signature R850 (most booked, includes a cinematic reel) · Premium Creative R1,000. Event coverage: Basic R2,000 · Half-Day R3,500 · Full Event R5,000. All sessions include creative direction, Lightroom retouching and a private gallery.

## Systems (software & automation)

AI automation and AI agents, custom web app and software builds, business-process optimization, and AI discoverability (structuring products and content to be found and recommended inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI search). Background as an AI-augmented data & migration engineer; 5+ applications built and deployed.

Pricing (South African Rand, indicative): Website from R2,000, most landing between R2,000 and R6,000 · Custom Build from R3,500, most landing between R3,500 and R12,000 · Automation from R5,000, most landing between R5,000 and R15,000. Every build is scoped to the problem.

## The Growth Partnership

A monthly retainer combining cinematic content with the systems that capture and convert it — the flagship bundle. From R1,500 a month, scoped to the business.
